payload.summary: Re-ran /validate-feature followup-add-decision-choices-ledger at HEAD e649daae, after VAL_FIX commit e649daae added two parametrized executable tests (TestCleanupFeatureStep5_5::test_step_5_5_branch_selection, TestValidateFeatureChoicesRow::test_choices_row_branch_selection) closing the nominal-coverage gap the prior validation pass (validate-aadfeb07) found on scenario skill-workflow.11. Rather than trusting the new tests because they exist and are green, I independently mutation-tested them: swapped the two empty-case branches in both skills/cleanup-feature/SKILL.md Step 5.5 and skills/validate-feature/SKILL.md Step 11, re-ran tests/audit-choices, and confirmed 6 tests failed (the 3 cleanup-gate cases + 3 of 4 validation-gate cases from the new parametrized tests, plus one pre-existing test that also checks the 'no ledger' wording) while the old string-presence test (test_both_empty_case_wordings_present) still passed under the mutation -- proving it really was blind to a branch swap and that the new tests genuinely discriminate. Restored both files with `git checkout --` (never git stash) and confirmed the tree matched HEAD exactly (git diff --stat empty) and the full suite returned to 133 passed. Then re-ran the rest of validation on its own terms: all four quality gates pass at expected counts (133 audit-choices, 124 ci_coverage, both linters clean), openspec validate --strict passes, every skill-workflow.8-.12 scenario re-assessed against spec.md and found REAL (fixture-driven, executable) including .10 and .11 which now have full branch coverage at both gates, all F1-F8 design decisions re-checked against design.md and shipped SKILL.md/script content including the F8 wording fix that landed in the same commit, all tasks.md items re-verified checked and shipped, and the two pre-existing out-of-scope conditions (make context-refresh repo-wide pending-merge failures including spec:skill-workflow, and tests/roadmap-runtime + tests/project-context-refresh collection ImportErrors) re-confirmed unchanged and unrelated to this diff. Result: PASS.

decisions.title: Returned outcome=passed only after independently reproducing the mutation test, not because the fix commit claimed to have done so
decisions.rationale: The phase brief was explicit: do not take the new tests at face value because they exist and are green. I performed the branch-swap mutation myself (not by reading the commit's description of it), observed the actual failing test names, confirmed the old nominal test still passed under the same mutation, and restored the files before re-running the full suite. This directly closes the same gap the prior FAIL identified, with fresh evidence rather than trust in the commit message.

decisions.title: Restored mutated files with git checkout -- and verified an empty diff before proceeding
decisions.rationale: The phase instructions required restoring afterwards and forbade git stash. I ran git diff --stat after the restore (not just git checkout) to have positive evidence the tree matched HEAD exactly before treating the test suite's subsequent 133-passed run as valid baseline evidence.

next_steps: None required for this change from a validation standpoint -- result is PASS.
